text:
maya: Heads-up — P1 from a customer using parallel function/tool calls. They say tool_result items are getting mixed up between tools when calls run in parallel. Happening ~1-2% of requests, hard to repro but consistent during load.

ingrid: Can you paste the full request payload + correlation id?

maya: payload below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "user": "acct-900",
  "modules": [
    {"tool": "lookup_user_profile", "args": {"user_id": "u-567"}},
    {"tool": "generate_summary",   "args": {"doc_id": "d-11"}}
  ],
  "mode": "parallel"
}
```

maya: correlation header: X-CORR-ID=req_abc123

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0458. Severity: P1. Assigned: eng-runtime. :rotating_light:

devon: I grabbed logs for req_abc123 from the runtime. Snippet shows a result mapping that looks wrong (tool field vs payload).
```
2026-03-16T14:23:10.012Z req=req_abc123 worker=gw-12 stage=invoke tool=lookup_user_profile -> exec_id=exec_322
2026-03-16T14:23:10.215Z req=req_abc123 worker=gw-12 stage=invoke tool=generate_summary -> exec_id=exec_333
2026-03-16T14:23:10.410Z req=req_abc123 worker=gw-12 stage=complete exec_id=exec_333 result_id=res_789 payload_tool=lookup_user_profile
2026-03-16T14:23:10.411Z req=req_abc123 worker=gw-12 stage=complete exec_id=exec_322 result_id=res_790 payload_tool=generate_summary
```

devon: Notice payload_tool on complete lines is flipped vs exec ids. That correlates to the customer-visible mismatch.

ingrid: Any trace/span ids? Need full trace to see if correlation header mutated or if mapping uses a non-unique key.

alex: Adding a couple of hypotheses: 1) result mapping keyed by ephemeral sequence tag that can collide under batching reuse, 2) worker reused an object pool and indices got reassigned before mapping write, 3) truncation of X-CORR-ID in log aggregation caused joins to mix results across concurrent requests.

maya: We have a trace id: trace=tr_ff7a2e. Linking a debug trace link (internal): https://traces.redwood.local/trace/tr_ff7a2e (request req_abc123).

devon: From the trace UI: two spans show identical call_index=0 for both tool calls on the gateway span, then child spans have index 0/1 — suggests gateway emitted same index for both when batching. Suspect a race in the index allocator.

ingrid: Repro steps I used locally (small harness):
1) send 50 concurrent requests with mode=parallel, 2 tools per request
2) capture response payloads and assert tool names match result.tool
3) failure seen ~2/50

payload used for repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-CORR-ID: repro_0001" -d '@repro_payload.json'
```
repro_payload.json same as above.

devon: I also saw that when gateway splits and fans out to runtime, it attaches a short call_key derived as sha1(request_id)[:8]. If two requests land on same worker and a small bug makes call_key generation use a shared buffer, collisions could happen.

alex: Next actions: eng-runtime to add a quick guard — include full uniq exec_id in the final mapping (not short call_key) and add an assertion to fail-fast if mapping sees duplicate keys within same request. Also add a temporary 5s sampling for request-level logging that dumps the per-call exec_id mapping for failing requests.

maya: For support: emailed customer with repro steps and told them we are on it. Asked for any additional samples.

ingrid: Can eng-runtime attach the raw worker logs for req_abc123 to INC-2026-0458 and link the PR/branch? Will help SRE and product when closing the ticket.

devon: Will instrument today. Tentative fix branch: runtime/fanout/fix-callkey-race. I'll include a small unit test that spawns concurrent fanouts and asserts unique keys.

alex: If QA repro is good, we should schedule a canary deploy to dedicated pool first. Keep me posted.

maya: Thanks — customers wants ETA. Can we aim for a canary by EOD tomorrow?

devon: Odds look good. If unit tests + local canary pass, EOD tomorrow seems reasonable.

support-bot: INC-2026-0458 updated: status=investigating, owner=devon, priority=P1.

ingrid: tagging @eng-runtime (thread) — please push logs and PR link.

maya: closing the loop here once PR is linked. :thumbsup:
